Rules.heading: Categorisation rules
Rules.intro: Categories are assigned in layers: your manual assignments are always kept, and your own rules take precedence over standard rules. Case, umlauts and long digit sequences (card or transaction numbers) are ignored. If several rules match, the first one wins; more specific patterns such as “amazon prime” automatically come before general ones such as “amazon”. Changing the category of an imported transaction teaches a rule. Your bank’s categories are not used.
Rules.autoIntro: Standard rules recognise common merchants and transaction types (e.g. REWE, Netflix, Deutsche Bahn, interest payments). Rules apply to every import; apply them here to existing transactions without a category. Automatically assigned categories are marked in the list.

Review.heading: Review list
Review.intro: Suggestions of the learning method for uncategorised transactions, least certain first. Amounts from {limit} always end up here, even with a confident match. Accepting or changing counts as your assignment – the method keeps learning from it.
